name: Beeswax
aliases: E901, INS 901, beeswax, bee wax, white beeswax, yellow beeswax, white wax, yellow wax
what_is: A wax obtained from honeybee combs. Food-grade E901 is available as yellow or white beeswax and can be used for functions including glazing, coating, stabilising and texturising.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E901 because it is bee-derived, is used as a food additive, and can perform glazing and textural functions in foods.
can_1: Identify E901, INS 901, beeswax and common white or yellow beeswax declarations.
can_2: Trigger the animal-origin, texture and E-number information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount present or the exact technological function used in a specific product from the ingredient list alone.
cannot_2: Determine the production or bleaching method, or suitability for an individual ethical or religious dietary rule, from the ingredient name alone.

sources.label: Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 — E901 beeswax specifications

title: Beeswax
description: A bee-derived wax used as food additive E901 for functions including glazing and texturising.
